visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a black t-shirt is outdoors on a wooden staircase. He talks excitedly to the camera, gesturing with his hands against a background of white doors and green trees. (2) Indoors, in a light-wood-floored living area, he holds and spins a black frying pan, demonstrating its balance while talking. (3) He returns to the stairs, holding the pan. Later, he is seen indoors standing on a digital body fat scale, looking intently at the handle's display. (4) He eats a vanilla ice cream bar in an office-like setting while a female colleague works in the background. (5) In a modern kitchen with white cabinetry, he chops sweet potatoes and beef on a wooden board. He then shows a bowl of cooked meat and vegetables to the camera. (6) He sits at a dining table and eats with chopsticks, nodding and expressing satisfaction. (7) He performs several exercises in a living room, including arm stretches, push-ups, and lifting a black kettlebell. A tabby cat walks around him and rests nearby. (8) Back in the kitchen, he prepares a 'coastal set meal' consisting of air-fried small fish, a bowl of seasoned seaweed, and roasted root vegetables. (9) He eats the meal at the table, taking large bites of the fish and seaweed dish. (10) A final animation shows two stylized characters standing in a minimalist yellow background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator throughout the video; 1 female colleague/friend appearing in background office and dining scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a black graphic t-shirt (referencing Godzilla or similar) and later a beige one, with light-colored shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Scenes alternate between an outdoor wooden porch area with green foliage, a modern interior with light wood flooring, a kitchen with white cabinetry, and a clean office space.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy over an upbeat acoustic guitar and drum BGM. A digital 'ding' sound effects punctuate the opening slogans. (2) The sound of a metal frying pan clinking against a wooden surface accompanies the man's dialogue. (3) Continuous beeping and clicking sounds of a digital scale interface occur. The male voice laughs loudly and shouts in surprise, followed by a faint female chuckle. (4) The sound of biting into a cold ice cream bar and the subsequent chopping of vegetables on a wooden board are clearly audible. (5) Heavy breathing, fabric rustling, and the rhythmic thud of feet jumping on a wooden floor mark the exercise sequence. A cat meows loudly twice. (6) Kitchen sounds intensify: the high-pitched whir of an air fryer, the bubbling of boiling water, and metallic lids being moved. (7) Audible chewing, slurping of soup, and the clinking of wooden chopsticks against ceramic plates dominate the final eating scenes. (8) A sweeping whoosh sound effect transitions the audio to a final fade-out with a short, melodic stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Routine Progress -> Activity -> Outcome
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents 'Day 36' of a 100-day weight loss journey. The creator shares weight measurement results, meal planning, and home workouts to entertain and motivate his audience through a humorous and high-energy vlog format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently features and demonstrates a Meyer (美亞) frying pan, and uses an Omron body composition scale, acknowledging the pan as a previously endorsed product.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and social-media-native graphics to maintain engagement. It blends personal health tracking with casual lifestyle storytelling.
